docs.text:
The stories of the epics and Purāṇas as Indian children heard them from their mothers, retold by Sister Nivedita (1907): the snake cycle, Śiva, Satī and Umā, Sāvitrī, the Rāmāyaṇa, the devotees.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Cradle tales of Hinduism · Nivedita, Sister, 1867-1911 · 1907, 370 scanned pages. Published 1907; Sister Nivedita (Margaret Noble) died 1911; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
